inferences: A mark left by an early danger or retreat return keeps a later range or hide search, or an area cache update reaching the same record, from going on through it; the danger and retreat searches cannot lose an area to it.
The range search leaves no mark of its own: it queues only unmarked records and its continued flood takes each off its queue.
fnTech3's pure gamestate budget is an engine policy (from Quake3e), not a retail contract; it must measure the gamestate clients are sent to keep a server from an overflow.
